name: number
summary: Displays app-formatted number text with persistent CSS digit columns that retarget compatible updates and snap incompatible shapes.

agent.useWhen: A text value should optionally roll changed digits after an app-owned update.
agent.avoidWhen: The value needs parsing, localization, financial calculation, inferred trend, or numeric interpolation.

native.scope: The locked declaration and browser installer require a real Native host build and browser lifecycle qualification.

invariants: Value is app-formatted, nonblank escaped text with no control characters; unknown properties are rejected.
Optional stable id uses a typed safe token (ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, colon; at most 128 bytes; no leading underscore); unknown properties are rejected.

Motion defaults to none; direction defaults to up; durationMs defaults to 320 and is bounded from 0 through 1000, with zero disabling transitions. Direction selects the digit-strip orientation: up stacks 0–9 and down stacks 9–0.

The first paint is canonical static text and never animates on mount. With roll motion, the installer adds one aria-hidden CSS odometer while the canonical label remains the accessibility source of truth and updates synchronously; neither label is a live region.

Compatible printable-ASCII LTR updates with unchanged prefix and suffix retarget persistent digit columns keyed from the right. Their separators must match within the shared right-aligned digits; extra leading digits or groups are allowed. New leading columns start at zero with CSS @starting-style, while removed leading columns are removed immediately.

Sign, prefix, suffix, or incompatible separator changes, RTL or non-ASCII text, labels over 64 glyphs, duration zero, reduced motion, and hidden documents snap to the latest value without cross-fading or overlapping labels. Roll motion uses CSS transitions only; JavaScript updates digit custom properties and does not use WAAPI.

The app updates only data-cui-number-value with its already-formatted label. A stable id permits the trusted host patch bridge to retain the owned DOM node; the installer admits only the Number value, motion, duration, direction, and presentation class from a matching incoming Number root. The canonical label always matches the latest value; cleanup removes the odometer and restores canonical visibility.
The component owns no domain state, parsing, localization, transport, financial operation, or command callback.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-number-digit
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Selects a digit position in the internal CSS odometer strip.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-number-duration
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls the CSS transition duration from the Number duration attribute.
